bibl.title: Two Festivals of the God Serapis in Greek Papyri.
bibl.seg: Youssri Abdelwahed, Two Festivals of the God Serapis in Greek Papyri.
bibl.note: Argues that the Serapia of Khoiak is a continuation of the Pharaonic and Ptolemaic festival of Osiris, whereas in Pharmuthi another aspect of the god Serapis, closer to the Greek Zeus, appears to have been celebrated.
